descriptionChirho: Masculine noun פַּעֲמֹן denoting a small bell, specifically the golden bells attached to the hem of the high priest's robe (me'il) alternating with pomegranates (Ex 28:33, 28:34, 39:25, 39:26). Also used of bells on horses in Zechariah's eschatological vision (Zech 14:20). The singular פַּעֲמֹן (eng: bell, spa: campanilla, hin: घण्टी, arb: جَرَسٌ, swa: kengele) and plural פַּעֲמֹנִים (eng: bells, spa: campanillas, hin: घंटियाँ, arb: أَجراسُ, swa: kengele) are inflectional variants of the same noun, not distinct senses.
